cases.transcript: I'm a software developer with about five years of experience building and scaling web applications, and I'm currently targeting a Senior Software Developer role. In my last position, I led the backend redesign of a customer platform serving more than 100,000 monthly users. I proposed moving one of our highest-traffic services to an asynchronous processing model after identifying database contention as the main bottleneck, and I worked with product and QA to plan the rollout without disrupting customers. The change reduced average processing time by about 35% and cut related production incidents by roughly 40%. I also introduced structured code reviews and mentored two junior developers, both of whom later took ownership of production features independently. I believe I'm a strong fit for a senior role because I can combine hands-on engineering with technical decision-making, cross-functional delivery, and helping other developers become more effective.
